hero.oneLiner: The deck positions Sathlokhar Synergys E&C Global Limited as a Chennai-based, fully in-house turnkey EPC contractor (design, civil, PEB, MEP, solar and interiors) for industrial and commercial clients, now backward-integrating into its own PEB steel fabrication manufacturing.

business_model.title: Positioning (investor deck)
business_model.body:
- Described as "a Chennai based EPC turnkey construction firm established in 2013, providing end to end turnkey execution across design, civil works, Pre engineered buildings (PEB) structures, Mechanical, Electrical, & Plumbing (MEP systems), solar installations, and interior fit outs", operating across industrial, commercial, institutional, warehousing, IBMS, utilities, solar, statutory approvals and healthcare sectors; listed on the NSE in August 2024.
- "Fully In House Execution Model" is the stated differentiator - integrated teams for design, civil, PEB, MEP and interiors, with an in-house design vertical (Archivo Infra Inc, launched 2018) and an in-house PEB unit (Sathlokhar Industries, launched 2023).
- Credentials cited: Super "A Grade" (ESA 635) Government Approved LT, HT & EHT Electrical Works Contractor; Tata Solar Power Authorized Channel Partner; PWD Class 1A Registration secured in 2026, which the deck says "enables participation in High value government civil and infrastructure tenders".
- Growth engine is repeat business: the Chairman states "Each of these is a client we are already executing for, and repeat work from existing clients is how this business grows", with Q1 FY27 additions from the Hong Fu group's Ranipet facility, Reliance Consumer Products at Kurnool and Ceylon Beverage Can in India and Sri Lanka.
- Milestones: first turnkey civil project 2015, first turnkey industrial project 2017, crossed Rs 400 Cr total revenue in 2025, and in 2026 crossed Rs 800+ Cr revenue and secured its first international order.

capital_allocation.title: Capital allocation policy (investor deck)
capital_allocation.body:
- "Long Term Debt Free - Zero Long Term Borrowings"; the restated balance sheet shows non-current borrowings of 0.00 in both FY25 and FY26, with borrowing entirely current (Rs 89.75 Cr in FY26 versus Rs 9.05 Cr in FY25).
- Leverage and returns for FY26: debt to equity 0.25 times (0.05 in FY25), interest coverage 18.67 times (24.49 in FY25), ROCE 26.06% (18.34% in FY25), ROE 22.93% (18.34% in FY25) and book value Rs 138.16 (Rs 77.13 in FY25).
- Growth is working-capital hungry and externally funded: FY26 cash flow from operating activities was negative Rs 162.95 Cr (FY25: negative Rs 96.39 Cr) against financing inflows of Rs 164.54 Cr (FY25: Rs 96.41 Cr), with inventories rising to Rs 138.39 Cr and other current assets to Rs 339.23 Cr.
- Net worth grew to Rs 358.92 Cr in FY26 from Rs 186.19 Cr in FY25 (equity Rs 25.98 Cr, reserves Rs 332.95 Cr); the deck mentions no dividend or buyback policy.
- CRISIL assigned an investment grade rating - long term BBB+/Positive and short term A2 on total bank facilities rated of Rs 200 Cr - which the deck says "Supports access to diversified bank funding" and "Enhances credibility with lenders and stakeholders".

other.title: Notable from the deck
other.body:
- [Order inflow] Q1 FY27 order inflow of Rs 272.05 Cr (including GST) across 7 orders secured, with named awards: Reliance Consumer Products Limited Rs 102.71 Cr for additional civil and PEB works at the CAMPA COLA beverage manufacturing facility at Brahmanapalli, Andhra Pradesh; Hong Fu Industrial Group (Taiwan based) Rs 22.53 Cr for Phase 1B at SIPCOT Industrial Park, Tamil Nadu and Rs 105.37 Cr for Phase 3 civil and PEB works; Ceylon Beverage Can Private Limited Rs 15.36 Cr (civil, PEB, MEP, processing pipeline, plant & machinery coordination) and Rs 3.68 Cr for additional MEP works at Boralugoda, Sri Lanka; EDAC Engineering Limited Rs 17.79 Cr; and Anabond Limited Rs 4.61 Cr.
- [International] The Ceylon Beverage Can order at Boralugoda, Sri Lanka is tied to the 2026 milestone "Secured First International Order".
- [Guidance] "We are holding to the view we gave at the start of the year on full year growth" - the deck does not restate what that full-year growth view is.
- [Market context] Indian PEB market shown at USD 2.3 Bn in FY25 rising to USD 4.5 Bn by FY30P on a 9-11% CAGR, with global PEB market at USD 23.8 Bn in 2025 to USD 48.1 Bn by 2032 at 10.6% CAGR, and Indian PEB penetration of only 3-5% (source cited: Niveshhaay).
- [Ownership] Shareholding as shown on the stock data slide: Promoter & Promoter Group 58.27%, Public 41.73%; share price Rs 318.75, market capitalization Rs 829.00 Cr, 2,59,78,592 shares outstanding, face value Rs 10, 52-week high and low Rs 580.00 and Rs 283.00 (the slide carries two as-on dates, 30th June 2026 and 1st August 2026, without indicating which applies to which block).
